Dialogs.Dialog: Anegasaki
Hey, thirsty？ Want me to grab us something to drink？
Thanks, please do!
No, ●'ll go!
Anything's fine？ Wait right here, okay？
Thanks for waiting, Master ▼
Huh？ Uh... 'You have my praise'？
Hehe, what a weird thing to say.
Well then, let's go together.
You could've just stayed and rested, though.
It's fine. I just don't want to be away from you.
Anegasaki
Oh, a bench is open. Want to take a short break？
Okay.
Phew, we've walked quite a bit, haven't we？
Let's take it easy.
Alright, once we rest up, we're back on the move!
Worrying about me？ I'll be fine once we rest for a bit.
It's fine, your legs must be tired, right？
Geez, and I was trying so hard not to show it. Thank you.
Yes, yes, look at you, full of energy.
I'm a guy, after all!
How dependable. Then if I get tired, you'll carry me on your back, right？
Anegasaki
Phew, it's getting warm. Maybe I'll take off a layer.
Go right ahead!
Better watch out for sunburn, though.
Somehow, hearing you say it like that... Oh well, whatever.
Phew.
Looks nice and cool. Maybe ● should take something off too.
Okay. Do you prefer fairer skin？
Not necessarily, but you worry about it sometimes, don't you？
It's the enemy of good skin, after all. Hehe, so you do care.
Anegasaki
It's a little chilly today, isn't it...？
Alright, come here!
Huddle battle time!
Okay, here I come.
...Hehe, so warm.
...Yeah, ● is too.
Are we really doing this？
Alright, I won't lose!
...There's winning and losing in this？ Oh well, take this!
Anegasaki
Oh, there's a stall set up. Mind if I go take a look？
Sure, take your time.
●'ll go check it out
All right, I'll go look. Be a good boy and wait here, okay？
Thanks for waiting! Since you were such a good boy, I brought you a treat.
Awesome!
●'ll go get it. Wait here.
Then I'm coming with you.
Hmm, did we buy too much？
Who knows... But you'll be fine. You're a boy, after all, right？
Anegasaki
Ah, a kitten! Look, look, it's so cute~▼
▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s way cuter...
●'s way cuter...
Eh？
...Never mind.
I heard that. ...Thank you.
What's this？ Are you getting jealous of a kitten？
That's not it, but...
Oh, you're impossible. Fine, I'll say it to you, too. You're so cute~▼
(...Well, this isn't bad either.)
Anegasaki
Whoa, the sun's really strong. Feels like I'll burn...
I'll put sunscreen on you
I'll put tanning oil on you
Good idea. I really need to protect against the UV rays.
Then...
I can put it on myself!
(Dang it...)
So you like tanned skin, huh？ Hmm...
Yeah, exactly, so ●...
...Hmm？
...Never mind.
Anegasaki
The view is so pretty... Hey, want to take a picture？
I'll take one of you
Let's ask someone to take it
Yeah, thanks! I can just be an extra in the background, okay？
What are you talking about？ The scenery's the extra here.
The two of us together？ Yeah, that sounds great.
All right. Here goes... Excuse me~!
Anegasaki
Whoa, what a crowd... This place must be really popular.
Guess everyone had the same idea
Coming all this way just to get shoved around in a crowd...
True. I guess it's just a classic date spot.
Well, a lively vibe isn't so bad either.
Aren't we doing the exact same thing, though？
...Fair point.
Maybe everyone else is thinking the exact same thing.
Anegasaki
It's pretty deserted here. I wonder if it's not very popular？
Picked a good day! Lucky us!
Feels a bit lonely...
Yeah. Feels like we can be all alone together, too？
Yeah.
We really think alike, don't we？
As long as I have you, that's enough for me.
Well, ● feels the same way.
Honestly, maybe it's even better with just us two？
Anegasaki
Too bad about the rain. I even prayed for sunshine, too...
Rain's no problem at all!
There are good things about the rain, too.
Aren't you energetic! Go blow the rain away with all that pep!
You got it!
Good things？ Like what？
Well, um... sharing an umbrella, maybe？
Hehe. Very true. Good boy for being honest.
Anegasaki
Hey, can I drop by your place today？
Of course.
Today's a bit tough...
I'm so glad. Well then, don't mind if I do, ▼
Haha, there's really not much to see, though.
I get it. It's a mess, isn't it？
Well, pretty much.
Geez, I wouldn't mind that! Next time, then？
Anegasaki
Hey, look, fortune-telling! Want to have our compatibility read？
I'll pass. I don't really believe in it.
Sounds interesting.
Really？ If that's what you think, that's fine, but...
Yeah. We don't really need that at this point.
My heart's pounding!
Fortune Teller
Your compatibility is the best! A bright future is guaranteed!
Wow, the best! A future together, huh...
(▲姉ヶ崎＊▲ looks totally enchanted...)
Your compatibility is quite good. Things should surely work out fine!
Yeah, it'll work out. ...Though isn't that a little underwhelming？
Hey, 'quite good' is plenty. It's up to ● anyway.
Your compatibility is... *cough, cough*!
...Hey, what is that supposed to mean？
Um... What's that about？
Anegasaki
Look, there's a flower blooming here. It's so cute.
Huh, good eye.
Speaking of cute...
Yeah, felt like it called to me. Maybe it was lonely blooming out of the way. Right？
(She's so cute...)
Speaking of cute... ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲'s way cuter.
Hehe, you're blushing! Jeez, which of us is the cute one here？
Anegasaki
Huh？ That girl coming this way... she's in my class.
Alright, let's show off!
Crap, hide!
Jeez, that's embarrassing! ...Let's just pretend we didn't see them.
(Maybe that was a bit much...)
You didn't have to be so shy. Looks like they went the other way, though？
(You're so calm about it, ▲姉ヶ崎＊▲...)
Anegasaki
Hey, want me to tidy up for you？
I can't make a guest do that...
Really？ Sweet!
I appreciate the thought, but being treated like a guest makes me a little lonely. Maybe some other time, then.
Sorry, I didn't mean it like that...
Jeez, you really don't hold back. Not that I mind, though.▼
All right~
Anegasaki
This is such a cozy room. Makes me want to stay forever.
Why don't you stay, then？
That's a bit...
Why not stay, then？ Even if it gets late, I'll walk you home.
...Oh, you're so innocent. You made my heart skip a beat for a second.
Jeez, don't take me so seriously. I wouldn't want to put you on the spot, anyway.
(...Maybe I overthought it.)
Anegasaki
Hey, can I look at your bookshelf？
Go right ahead, take your time.
Definitely not!
You agreed so easily! I thought you'd panic a little.
(I've got nothing to panic about... right？)
I'd love to see albums from when you were little. Can I？
(That kind of thing is kind of embarrassing, though...)
Anegasaki
Make yourself at home, okay？ Just relax.
Way ahead of you!
Easier said than done...
I didn't mean lounge around sloppily, you know？ Hehe, you're like a little kid.
(Somehow, it's really calming...)
Just act like you always do. There, there, nothing to be scared of.
(...She's treating me like a kid.)
Anegasaki
I wonder if we should get some things just for you？
That sounds nice.
You really don't have to go out of your way...
I really like that. Feels like a real couple.
Not 'feels like.' We're a real couple, right？
Really？ I think it'd be lots of fun, though...
I just don't want you pushing yourself, okay？
Anegasaki
Sorry. It's kind of a mess in here, isn't it？
Not at all!
It's way cleaner than I expected.
If this counts as messy, ●, your room must be...
Hey, if you live like a slob, I might just have to barge in on you, you know？
Than you expected？ How mean! Just what were you imagining？
Hahaha...
